npcs.notes: Status: Night 1. Has run the brass elevator since the 1950s and still wears the gloves. She will take you to floors that are not on the directory, if you ask politely and know the number. npcs.notes: Status: Mortalis 1. Works the downtown courtrooms and has noticed official transcripts changing after the fact. Keeps her own shorthand notebooks at home as a second record, and those do not change. Singing alto in her church choir is the only time she stops listening for edits.
